help.usage:
Usage: guideline <command> [options]

In a project (guideline server)
  common --source <name>   a source (sources in guideline.json). For pick, an unknown name together with --server adds a new source
  pick     choose guidelines to export in a web form; submitting applies them to this project
             --project <path>    target project (default: current directory)
             --new <name|path>   create a new project (a bare name goes under GUIDELINE_PROJECTS_DIR)
             --server <URL>      guideline server (default: guideline.json → GUIDELINE_SERVER)
             --no-browser        print the address instead of opening a browser
             --recommend <file|->  Pre-check blocks an agent chose (JSON: block key → reason; with --local also {"add": {…}, "remove": {…}})
             --local             choose only your own additions and removals for this project (stored in the git common directory, committed files stay unchanged; needs git)
             --role <name>       with --local: choose that personal role's layer on top of your common choice (created if missing; guideline role use applies it)
             --json              print the result (written files, to-dos) as JSON
  update   re-apply the chosen items from the latest server revision
             --project <path>  --server <URL>
             --force             also overwrite files changed in the project
             --json              print the result as JSON
  status   show whether the applied guidelines are current, what the project changed, and the token's scope
             --project <path>  --server <URL>  --json
  apply    compose the agent files from .guideline/ without the server, then run ruler (after a clone, in a new worktree or in prepare)
             --project <path>  --json
  role     show this worktree's personal role and the roles defined in each unit (committed files stay unchanged; needs git)
             guideline role  --json
             use <name>          set this worktree's role and apply from the git root
             use --none          clear the role and apply from the git root
             remove <name>       delete the role's definition in this unit (no apply)
             --project <path>
  login    log in to a guideline server, store a token and show its scope (read, propose or admin)
             --server <URL>
             --token-stdin       store a token from standard input instead of using a browser
  logout   delete the stored token and revoke it on the server
             --server <URL>
  propose  turn edited copies back into source form and propose them to the server (they become source when an admin accepts; with an admin token they are applied directly)
             --project <path>  --server <URL>
             --title <title>     proposal title (default: guidelines edited in <directory>)
             --message <text>    proposal description
             --only <item,…>     only these items (e.g. rules/base/01-git.md,skills/s)
             --from <folder>     compare a folder from guideline source against the revision it came from (--title required)
             --dry-run           show the changes and diffs without sending
             --apply             apply directly (needs an admin token; the default with an admin token)
             --review            send a proposal that waits for review, even with an admin token
             --json              print the result as JSON
  source   unpack the latest server source into an empty folder; edit it in source layout, then propose --from
             guideline source <folder>  --server <URL>
  list     list the source and its checks. With a folder, read that folder (a source from guideline source); otherwise the server
             guideline list [folder]  --server <URL>  --json
  proposals  list the server's proposals, or show one with its per-file diffs
             guideline proposals [number]  --server <URL>  --json
             --status <status>   list only: pending, accepted or rejected
  locale   language packs: check <folder> compares a pack with English; list shows available languages. The language is GUIDELINE_LANG
             guideline locale check <folder>  guideline locale list  --json
  help     this help

manage.docsReadme: This directory is generated by `guideline apply` from the copies in `.guideline/`, and the next apply rewrites it. Do not edit it — change the copies in `.guideline/` (propose fixes upstream with `guideline propose`) and run `guideline update` to bring them up to date.

manage.setupIntro: - When setting up the project (when a stack is first received, after a fresh clone, or when the setup looks wrong), read and follow the documents below. Picking a stack is the decision to bring that technology into this project. Do not skip the setup because the project does not use that technology yet — the setup is the step that brings it in. If you cannot do the setup (permissions, a setting a person must change in an app, and so on), tell the user instead of skipping it.
manage.personalIntro: This worker layered the personal selection below on top of the project's selection. The personal selection lives only in this worker's git repository and is not committed. Generated files that come only from the personal scope are listed in git's `info/exclude`, not in `.gitignore`.
manage.personalSetup: Set up personal-scope stacks (marked “{mark}” in the setup table) by following their setup documents, but do not change committed files. Do not skip a step that would (a committed config file, `.gitignore`, and so on) — tell the user instead.

pick.recommendOneSource: --recommend works on one source at a time — add --source <name>
pick.recommendRead: Could not read the recommendation file: {reason}
pick.badRecommend: The recommendation must be JSON of the form {"block key": "reason"} (with --local also {"add": {…}, "remove": {…}})
pick.serverOld: This server is older than the CLI — picking stacks needs a guideline server 0.24.0 or newer. Ask the server operator to upgrade, or use an older CLI
pick.recommendUnknown: Recommended blocks not in the source: {keys}
web.client.autoChecked: {by} needs {needs}, so it was checked too
web.client.autoReleased: {needs} was unchecked too because {by} was unchecked
migrate.dirty: Commit or stash your changes first — moving to the new layout rewrites tracked files
migrate.done: Moved this project to the new layout: copies are in .guideline/, generated files are listed in .gitignore. Review with git status and commit
migrate.manifestV3: guideline.json now lists whole stacks (version 3) — the rest of each chosen stack's files were added
manifest.sourceBadRequired: sources.{name}.required: must be a list of block keys
manifest.requiredNotChosen: sources.{name}.required: {item} is not in items — a required block has to be one of the chosen blocks
local.badFile: Cannot read {file} — it is not a valid personal selection. Fix it, run guideline apply to bring your personal selection back, then run pick --local to change it. If you delete it instead, remove the MCP servers you added on top of the project's from .mcp.json and the other agents' settings yourself
defaults.badFile: Cannot read {file} — it is not a valid machine defaults file. Fix or delete it
defaults.badServer: Cannot save machine defaults for {server} — it is not a server URL
web.form.requiredRemove: Required blocks and the stacks above them cannot be removed: {keys}
web.client.requiredHint: Nobody can remove this block in a personal selection. Only a chosen block can be required
web.client.personal.intro: Change only what you receive here. The project's choice and the committed files stay as they are.
web.client.personal.inRoleBasis: project + my common selection get it
web.client.personal.notInRoleBasis: project + my common selection do not get it
web.client.personal.lockedAncestor: Holds a required block — cannot remove
web.client.personal.preset.local: Pre-checked: my selection for this project
web.client.personal.saveDefault: Save this selection as my default
web.client.personal.saveDefaultHint: Pre-checks this form in projects where you have no personal selection yet
web.client.personal.ancestorAdded: {needs} was added too — {by} is under it
web.client.personal.ancestorKept: {needs} is back to the project's choice — {by} is under it
web.client.personal.childrenReset: Child stacks back to the project's choice: {n}
web.client.personal.confirmEmpty: No personal changes — you get exactly what the project chose
local.needsGit: The personal scope needs this folder to be in a git repository, and git 2.31 or newer (git rev-parse --path-format). Not a git repository, or git is too old
pick.localAndNew: --local and --new cannot be used together — run guideline pick --new first, then pick --local in that project
pick.serverOldPersonal: This server does not know the personal form — pick --local needs a newer guideline server. Ask the server operator to upgrade
pick.recommendRequired: Cannot recommend removing required blocks (or stacks that contain one): {keys}
pick.localShadowed: {item}: not added — the project chose the block with the same name ({final}) from source {by}, so your copy would never be used
pick.localShadowedBelow: {item}: not added, nor the blocks below it ({below}) — the project chose the block with the same name ({final}) from source {by}, so your copies would never be used, or would be mixed into that source's stack
pick.defaultsConflict: {origin} defaults: {key} was chosen differently in sources {first} and {last}; saved the choice of {last}
role.notGit: Not in a git repository — a role is set per git worktree
role.unknownAction: Unknown role action: {action} — use or remove
role.extraArgs: Too many arguments — guideline role [use <name> | use --none | remove <name>]
role.useArgs: Give a role name or --none, not both — guideline role use <name> or guideline role use --none
role.removeArgs: Give the role to remove — guideline role remove <name>
role.badName: A role name starts with a lowercase letter and uses lowercase letters, digits and -, up to 32 characters: {name}
role.notDefined: Role {name} is not defined in any unit — create it with guideline pick --local --role {name}
role.notDefinedHere: Role {name} is not defined in this unit ({unit})
role.bad: This worktree's role file is broken — run guideline role use <name> or guideline role use --none
role.removed: Removed the definition of role {name} from this unit ({unit})
role.noneOnlyUse: --none is only for guideline role use — guideline role use --none
role.applyFailedRestored: Applying failed, so the role was set back — {name}
role.applyPartialKept: The role is now {name}, but part of applying failed — fix it, then guideline apply
role.notUnit: Not a guideline unit (no guideline.json): {dir} — run guideline role remove in the unit's folder
todo.roleRemovedApply: Removed the definition of this worktree's role {name} — run guideline apply to apply it
